svg.aria-label: One job: you ask Claude Code, Claude Code delegates to vNext, vNext starts a worker on Codex, Z.ai or Command Code, the worker answers, vNext writes a record into .vnext/ and wakes Claude Code with the report
svg.desc: 1 You type: Claude Code, "Use vNext to give a worker this job". 2 delegate. vNext, an MCP server. 3 start: Worker on Codex, Worker on Z.ai, Worker on Command Code. 4 answer. 5 record: .vnext/ in your project, model, time, tokens. 6 wakes you with the report.
